title: Vadhandhi season 2
summary:
Vadhandhi: The Mystery of Mani is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language mystery crime thriller streaming television series created, written and directed by Andrew Louis for Amazon Prime Video. It is the second installment of the Amazon Prime's Vadhandhi franchise. The show was produced by S. Guhapriya, S. Nandakumar, and Gowtham Selvaraj under the Wallwatcher Films banner and creatively produced by Pushkar–Gayathri.
The principal cast of the series includes M. Sasikumar, Yashwanth, Anagha, Aparna Das, Vivek Prasanna, Revathy Sharma and Arjun Nandhakumar. The series premiered on Amazon Prime Video on 7 August 2026 and consists of eight episodes.
plot: The series revolves around a police officer, SI Moosa Raaza, who is transferred to Madurai for his punishment. There, he solves a false political case. But he realizes that his success may have sent an innocent man to life imprisonment. He is drawn back into a tangled web of buried secrets.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was announced as a part of Amazon Prime Video's future slate of content in March 2026. The show is the second season of 2022's Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie with a different cast and story. Produced by S Guhapriya, S Nandakumar, and Gowtham Selvaraj under the Wallwatcher Films banner. Creative produced by Pushkar–Gayathri, who produced in the first season. The same director, Andrew Louis, who directed the first season, has returned to write and direct this season.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: On March 2025, Tamil film director and actor, M. Sasikumar was cast as police officer SI Moosa Raaza. This is his second role in a limited series after Nadu Center (2025). Actress Anagha and Aparna Das are playing important role. Actor Vivek Prasanna reprises his role from Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Amazon Prime Video released the series' first teaser on 19 March 2026. The series premiered on 7 August 2026, with all eight episodes released simultaneously. It was released in Tamil and dubbed in Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, and Kannada.

title: Vimal Khanna
summary: Vimal Khanna is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language crime thriller television series adapted from Vimal series by author Surender Mohan Pathak. It is directed by Abhhinav Pareek and written by Uddeept Dutt Gaur for Amazon MX Player. It stars Sunny Hinduja in the titular role alongside Isha Talwar.
reception: Abhishek Srivastava of The Times of India gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "‘Vimal Khanna’ Season One settles into being an average but watchable thriller because it often chooses surface-level storytelling over layered elements. It delivers enough suspense and a dependable central performance to satisfy viewers looking for an uncomplicated crime drama, though it rarely aims higher than that."

title: Vaagai Sooda Vaa
summary:
Vaagai Sooda Vaa (transl. Come, wear the crown of victory) is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language family Melodrama television series starring Irfan and Pavithra Aravind in lead roles. The series explores the complex relationship between a grandmother and her grandson and middle-class girl Meenakshi, set against the backdrop of family dynamics and traditions.
It is produced by Devan Charles, P. Praveen Kumar and Saranya Veeramani under the banner of Parable Pictures and directed by Prathap Mani. It premiered on Zee Tamil on 26 January 2026, and airs on Monday to Saturday at 21:30 and streams digitally on ZEE5.
plot:
The series is set in Madurai. The story is about a middle-class family headed by a single mother, Sumathi (Gayathri Shastri) After her husband abandons her, she raises her daughters, Thenmozhi and Meenakshi, with values. Thenmozhi, a tailor, is the eldest daughter is soft spoken. Meenakshi, the youngest, is brave and aspires to achieve her dream of becoming a lawyer.
Annapurani (Kuyili), is the money-minded matriarch who rules her family. Her youngest grandson Jeevanantham opposes his grandmother. Thenmozhi marries into Mano's debt-ridden family. But, to protect Thenmozhi and restore the family's dignity, Meenakshi weds Jeeva, Mano’s younger brother. Meenakshi faces challenges in the form of Annapurani. But her husband Jeevanatham supports and helps her to achieve and fulfill the dreams.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Vaagai Sooda Vaa was produced by Devan Charles, P. Praveen Kumar and Saranya Veeramani under the banner of Parable Pictures. The series is directed by Prathap Mani, known for his series like Deivam Thantha Poove (2021–2023), Thavamai Thavamirundhu (2022–2023), Sandhya Raagam (TV series) (2024) Valliyin Velan (2024–2025) and written by Alvin Prashanth Raj.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Actor Irfan was cast as the male lead Jeevanantham, making his comeback to acting in Television serials after JioHotstar’s Kana Kaanum Kaalangal. Actress Pavithra Gowda plays the lead role as Meenakshi in the series, making her comeback to acting in Television serials after Star Vijay’s Kanne Kalaimaane.
Veteran Tamil actress Kuyili was cast as the main negative lead Annapurani, making her comeback to acting in Tamil serials after 4 years. Her last approach in Zee Tamil serial Ninaithale Inikkum. Gayatri Shastri was cast in the important role as Sumathi, for her notable performance in Roja. The series also reunited R. Karuna Vilasini, Shakthi and Ajay Rathnam who previously acted together in Pandian Stores 2. Vichithra was cast as Police officer S. Kalaiyarasi in special appearances.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
On 1 January 2026, the first Launch promo was released, which gave a brief insight into both Meenakshi and Jeevanatham's lives.
It began airing on Zee Tamil, from 26 January on Monday to Saturday at 21:30, replacing Parijatham time slot.

title: Veduvan
summary: Veduvan is an Indian Tamil-language action thriller streaming web series directed by Pavan and produced by Srinidhi Sagar under the banner of Rise East. The series stars Kanna Ravi in a lead role, with Sanjeev Venkat, Sravnitha Srikanth, Vinusha Devi, Rekha Nair, and Lavanya in supporting roles. It premiered on ZEE5 on 10 October 2025. Set in a coastal town, Veduvan follows a chain of events triggered by a mysterious incident that unearths old grievances and buried secrets.
plot: The story follows Sooraj, an aspiring actor who secures the role of Arun, an encounter specialist, in a film. As he immerses himself in the character, Sooraj begins to understand the moral dilemmas and hidden truths that define the role. The lines between his reel and real lives begin to blur, drawing him into a tense web of love, betrayal, and corruption. The series examines how an actor's pursuit of authenticity leads him to confront questions that go beyond the story he set out to tell.
reception: The Scroll.in review commended Kanna Ravi's performance but observed that the show's moral commentary was tentative and the narrative lacked urgency. Anusha Sundar of OTTPlay rated the series 2 out of 5 stars, writing that "Veduvan, which dances with concepts of morality and responsibility, ends up dilly-dallying with overly simplistic choices of writing. Even as the cast puts up a decent show, the efforts that have gone on paper are starkly visible and somewhat disjointed." Jonson of Puthiya Thalaimurai rated the series 1 out of 5 stars, stating that "the only consolation of this series is that it is spread over seven episodes and runs for a total of two hours. Overall, if they had added new and interesting things, this Veduvan would have kept me interested." Cinema Inbox wrote that "being an actor, Kanna Ravi has got the opportunity to play various roles in this series. Kanna Ravi, who perfectly carries himself in all the varied characters including a police officer, beggar, and cook, delivers an impressive performance."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Veduvan is directed by Pavan and produced by Srinidhi Sagar of Rise East. The technical crew includes Vipin Bhaskar as composer, Srinivaasan Devaraj as cinematographer, and S. Surajkavee as editor.
Filming took place in and around Sivagangai, with several scenes shot in suburban and rural settings such as local villages and bus stations. The production was completed within an 18-day schedule. Actor Kanna Ravi described the experience as one of the most demanding projects of his career due to the tight filming timeline and the psychological depth of his role.

articleSections.text: The official trailer for Veduvan was released on 27 September 2025. The series premiered on ZEE5 on 10 October 2025.

episodesList.summary: A washed-up actor, Sooraj, finds hope in a daring new script about encounter specialist Arun and becomes drawn into the cop’s violent past after Arun kills gangster Guna.

episodesList.title: The Man in the Shadows
episodesList.summary: Guna’s public execution shocks Chennai. His widow, Yashoda, vows revenge while the police brand the killing self-defence, and Arun struggles to keep his identity secret.

episodesList.title: The Calm Before the Storm

episodesList.title: The Predator
episodesList.summary: Arun discovers that Aadhi has married his former love, Shanthi. Suspecting Arun’s motives, Aadhi warns him to leave; Arun instead makes a bold, risky move.

episodesList.title: The Kill
episodesList.summary: During a village-festival fireworks display, Arun secretly shoots Aadhi. At the funeral he comforts a grief-stricken Shanthi and her children while hiding his guilt.

episodesList.title: The Weight of the Bullet
episodesList.summary: Though feted as a hero, Arun is rattled by Aadhi’s death. Back in Chennai he questions the justice system and faces a life-altering decision.

episodesList.title: The Truth, As We Know It
episodesList.summary: While portraying Arun on film, Sooraj uncovers disturbing facts about the officer’s demise. The movie is a hit, but Sooraj is haunted by the truth he has learned.

title: Varisu
summary: Varisu is a 2025 Indian Tamil language Family Drama television series that premiered from 30 June 2025 airing on Zee Tamil and streams digitally on ZEE5. It stars Haritha Jackie, Swetha Dorathy and Jay Srinivas in lead role. It is produced by Arun Ira under the banner of Sapphire Blue Production Private Limited and directed by Sivasekar. Due to its success and high ratings at the matinee slot, Varisu has been dubbed in Telugu, titled Kongu Bangaram, airing on Zee Telugu.
plot:
The series focuses on the wealthy Janakambal family who live in their lavish house. Tamilarasi is a bright and ambitious young woman from the traditional town of Karaikudi. Her parents were loving. She has two younger sisters Thenmozhi and Isaivani. Tamilarasi's wedding is halted. Because her father goes missing, the family is left bankrupt, and her fiancé deserts her.
After her father's disappearance, Tamilarasi and her family moved to Chennai. She meets Cibi and the duo get into a misunderstanding. He is the grandson of Janakambal, a successful entrepreneur, who wants her reckless grandson Cibi to succeed her. She brings in Tamilarasi to set him straight. However, long-buried secrets emerge, relationships fracture and mend, and Tamilarasi takes care of her family and faces all of life's issues calmly.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
The series stars Haritha Thota as lead role in her second collaboration of acting in a Tamil television series after Kulavilakku, making her comeback after 21 years. Actress Swetha Dorathy plays the lead role in the series alongside Ilakkiya and Meena fame Jay Srinivas, marking her debut appearance in a television series. Actors Sonia was cast as Cibi mother's Meena.
Actor Yogeswaram was cast as Supporting role as Premkumar, but was replaced by Ashwanth Thilak in October 2025.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
On 10 June 2025, the first Launch promo was released, giving a brief insight into Janakambal's past life as well as the first interaction between her grandson Cibi and Tamizh's marriage. The second promo was released on 22 June 2025, revealing the release date.
It began airing on Zee Tamil, from 30 June 2025 on Monday to Saturday at 13:30, replacing Mounam Pesiyadhe time slot.

title: Viraatapalem
summary: Viraatapalem: PC Meena Reporting is a 2025 Telugu-language supernatural thriller that premiered on ZEE5 on 26 June 2025. The series is directed by Poluru Krishna, known for the crime drama Recce, and produced by K. V. Sriram under the South Indian Screens banner. It stars YouTuber-turned-actress Abhignya Vuthaluru in the title role, alongside Charan Lakkaraju.
plot: Set in the 1980s in the fictional village of Viraatapalem, the series follows a mysterious curse believed to cause newlywed brides to die on their wedding day. As a result, marriages have been avoided in the village for over a decade. Police constable Meenakshi, known as PC Meena, is transferred to the village and begins investigating the deaths. She is joined by Kittu, a reformed convict, as they explore the village's past and attempt to uncover the truth behind the incidents.
reception:
Viraatapalem: PC Meena Reporting received mixed to negative reviews from critics.
Chitrajyothy described the series as a "nail-biting thriller" with a promising storyline but noted inconsistencies in screenplay and pacing that diluted its impact. Deccan Chronicle remarked that "Viraatapalem starts with a promising premise of a cursed village and a determined female constable, but unfortunately, it gets lost in its own underdeveloped plot. Despite flashes of potential in its suspense and commentary on workplace gender dynamics, the series ultimately delivers a predictable and routine narrative."
Siddartha Toleti of M9 News observed that the series "has a decent setup. However, the execution and the writing are so amateurish that it’s impossible to stick through, even for hardcore thriller lovers.". 123Telugu echoed similar sentiments, stating that "Viraatapalem: PC Meena Reporting is a textbook example of how a decent concept can be dragged down by clueless writing, lifeless performances, and carelessly stitched episodes that lead absolutely nowhere."
Scroll.in highlighted the protagonist, a tough cop investigating mysterious deaths. Avad Mohammad of OTTplay rated 2.5 out of 5 stars and stated "The Abhigya Vuthaluru starrer starts on an interesting note but gets botched up and become a forced crime thriller."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series is developed by South Indian Screens in collaboration with ZEE5. It was filmed in rural Andhra Pradesh. Poluru Krishna directed the series, while the original story was conceived by Divya Thejaswi Pera and adapted into a screenplay by Vikram Kumar Kandimalla.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Viraatapalem: PC Meena Reporting was released on ZEE5 on 26 June 2025.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text:
Viraatapalem: PC Meena Reporting received mixed to negative reviews from critics.
Chitrajyothy described the series as a "nail-biting thriller" with a promising storyline but noted inconsistencies in screenplay and pacing that diluted its impact. Deccan Chronicle remarked that "Viraatapalem starts with a promising premise of a cursed village and a determined female constable, but unfortunately, it gets lost in its own underdeveloped plot. Despite flashes of potential in its suspense and commentary on workplace gender dynamics, the series ultimately delivers a predictable and routine narrative."

episodesList.title: The Red Wedding
episodesList.summary: Residents of Viraatapalem attribute the recent death of a newlywed woman, Durga, to a local curse. Meanwhile, Meena, a young police officer, is assigned to the village to investigate.

episodesList.title: The Bride and the Curse
episodesList.summary: Ranga, a villager, marries Malli despite local superstitions surrounding a curse. Shortly afterward, Malli collapses near the temple and dies suddenly, leading the community to attribute her death to the rumored curse.

episodesList.title: Staking It All
episodesList.summary: Meena attempts to file a case regarding Malli’s unexplained death, but the process is delayed. During this time, the village president proposes that Meena marry his son, and he is taken aback by her response.

episodesList.title: Encounter With The Truth
episodesList.summary: As preparations for Meena’s wedding to the village president’s son commence, villagers grow increasingly anxious that the curse will claim another victim. When Meena collapses during the celebrations, she responds by officially filing a case, identifying herself as a target of the supposed curse.

episodesList.title: Forever Bride
episodesList.summary: Meena initiates a thorough investigation to uncover the truth behind the unexplained deaths. As her inquiry progresses, her wedding is suddenly canceled. Her pursuit of the case leads her into increasingly perilous circumstances.

episodesList.title: The Last Straw
episodesList.summary: Meena’s investigation is hindered when she receives a transfer order. During a visit to the headquarters, she learns that Narsayya was behind the recommendation for her transfer. Suspecting ulterior motives, Meena begins to investigate Narsayya’s background.

episodesList.title: Mystery of Viraatapalem
episodesList.summary: With the village president’s support, Meena assists two villagers in getting married, challenging the widespread fear of the curse. Meanwhile, she races to uncover the true cause of the deaths before anyone else becomes a victim.

plotHtml: Set in the 1980s in the fictional village of Viraatapalem, the series follows a mysterious curse believed to cause newlywed brides to die on their wedding day. As a result, marriages have been avoided in the village for over a decade. Police constable Meenakshi, known as PC Meena, is transferred to the village and begins investigating the deaths. She is joined by Kittu, a reformed convict, as they explore the village's past and attempt to uncover the truth behind the incidents.

title: Veer Hanuman
summary: Veer Hanuman, also known as Veer Hanuman – Bolo Bajrang Bali Ki Jai, is an Indian Hindi-language mythological television series aired from 11 March 2025 to 8 September 2025 on Sony SAB. The show is produced by Siddharth Kumar Tewary under Swastik Productions.
plot: The series chronicles the journey of Lord Hanuman from his childhood as Maruti to becoming a symbol of unwavering devotion and supernatural strength. Set in the mythical kingdom of Kishkindha, the story follows young Maruti as he gradually uncovers his divine identity. Guided by his parents and spiritual mentors, he embarks on a journey that brings him into contact with various deities and key figures from Hindu mythology. The show emphasizes Hanuman’s internal evolution, focusing on devotion, humility, valor, and the virtues that make him the ideal devotee of Lord Rama.
reception: Critics appreciated the show’s spiritual tone and its effort to present the epic’s stories to a modern audience with fresh.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Aan Tiwari as young Hanuman (Maruti) * Arav Chowdharry as Kesari, Hanuman’s father * Sayli Salunkhe as Anjana, Hanuman’s mother

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: Veer Hanuman is produced by Swastik Productions, known for their previous mythological dramas such as Mahabharat and RadhaKrishn. The show is filmed primarily in Mumbai, using expansive sets that replicate the architectural styles of ancient India. The design team drew inspiration from the cave art of Ajanta and Ellora to reflect historical accuracy in costumes and settings. The series incorporates advanced VFX and CGI technology to depict divine miracles and supernatural battles, aiming to offer a visually immersive experience. The show was promoted using 3D holographic sky projection technology in Ujjain during Mahashivratri as part of a promotional campaign by Sony SAB. This projection used scrim technology to create a 360-degree visual experience of Lord Hanuman.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Critics appreciated the show’s spiritual tone and its effort to present the epic’s stories to a modern audience with fresh.

episodesList.title: Dharm Ki Chingari
episodesList.summary: In Kishkindha, Rajkumar Bali defeats the Asurs and scolds his sena for retreating during the battle. Later, Devi Anjana learns that an avatar of Mahadev is destined to be born through her.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Ki Kripa
episodesList.summary: Bali has a disturbing dream of being struck down by an arrow. Meanwhile, Raja Kesari confronts Devi Anjana, and later, Jamvant Ji advises Bali about his mistakes on the battlefield.

episodesList.title: Asato Maa Sadgamey
episodesList.summary: Mahabali Rikshraj, Bali, and Sugriva receive a warm welcome from Maharaj Kesari. Meanwhile, Lord Indra visits Devi Anjana. Later, Bali questions Lord Indra about the reason for his visit.

episodesList.title: Sankat Mochan Ka Janam
episodesList.summary: Devi Anjana goes into labour but remains anxious and uneasy. As Raja Kesari grows concerned, Maharaj Rikshraj tries to reassure him. Eventually, Devi Anjana gives birth to her son.

episodesList.title: Sumeru Ka Bhavishya
episodesList.summary: Devi Anjana fears that, as per the curse, she will have to return to heaven. Meanwhile, Sugriva informs Bali about the birth of Anjana Putra. Later, Raja Kesari names his son Maruti.

episodesList.title: Jal Shodan Sanskar
episodesList.summary: Punjikastala performs the Jal Shodan Sanskar in Swarg Lok while longing for her newborn son. Later, on their way to Kishkindha, Maruti accidentally falls into the river.

episodesList.title: Prahar Se Mukti
episodesList.summary: Maruti arrives at the Asurs' cave, while in Brahmalok, Punjikastala performs a dance and confronts Brahmadev. Later, Maruti helps free an Asur from his curse.

episodesList.title: Veerta Ki Pariksha
episodesList.summary: Maruti watches his father train with the Gada and grows curious. Meanwhile, Bali plots a way to eliminate Maruti. Later, an Asur, disguised as a Rishi, attempts to attack Maruti.

episodesList.title: Sahas Ka Sanchaar
episodesList.summary: The Asur is captured and presented before Raja Kesari, but before he can speak, Bali kills him. Meanwhile, Maruti recounts the incident to his mother.

episodesList.title: Buddhi Mein Dhani Maruti
episodesList.summary: Maruti asks his mother for permission to leave the palace. Later, he befriends a boy named Neel.

episodesList.title: Prakriti Ki Den
episodesList.summary: Maruti rescues his friend Neel, who thanks him with mangoes. Meanwhile, Devi Anjana and Maharaj Kesari search for Maruti. Later, Maruti mistakes the sun for a mango and heads toward it.

episodesList.title: Veer Aur Chatur Maruti
episodesList.summary: As Maruti moves toward the Sun, Jatayu tries to stop him, warning him about how his brother Sampati perished after getting too close. Meanwhile, Devi Anjana frantically searches for her son.

episodesList.title: Surya Grahan Ka Adhikaar
episodesList.summary: Rahu intercepts Maruti before he can reach the sun. Meanwhile, Bali assures Devi Anjana and Maharaj Kesari that he has no part in Maruti's disappearance. Later, Rahu narrates the tale of the Samudra Manthan to Maruti.

episodesList.title: Rahu Ka Krodh
episodesList.summary: Maruti challenges Rahu and continues his journey toward the sun, while Devi Anjana and Raja Kesari pray to Lord Shiva. Later, Rahu turns to Lord Indra for assistance.

episodesList.title: Pranam Ke Badle Prahar
episodesList.summary: In Surya Lok, Yam Dev advises Surya Dev to teach Maruti a lesson rather than harm him. Despite Agni Dev and Varun Dev's attempts to stop him, Maruti continues forward. Later, he comes face-to-face with Yam Dev.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Ki Urja
episodesList.summary: Maruti overpowers Yam Dev and continues his journey toward the Sun. Later, Surya Dev confronts him, but Maruti astonishes everyone by taking the Sun into his mouth.

episodesList.title: Sampoorn Sansar Andhkar Mein
episodesList.summary: Indra Dev confronts Maruti and strikes him, causing him to fall back to Earth. Meanwhile, Devi Anjana continues her prayers to Lord Shiva.

episodesList.title: Moorchit Maruti
episodesList.summary: Vayu Dev challenges Indra Dev for his actions, while Bali rejoices over Maruti's presumed death. Later, Vayu Dev withdraws air from the three loks.

episodesList.title: Bal Ka Abhimaan
episodesList.summary: The Devtas present their arguments to Lord Vishnu, but Lord Shiva scolds them for their actions against Maruti. Later, they apologise to Vayu Dev.

episodesList.title: Maruti Ke Liye Vardaan
episodesList.summary: Maruti receives blessings from the Gods and Devtas. Later, Devi Anjana rejoices as she reunites with her son.

episodesList.title: Naam Hanuman
episodesList.summary: Devi Anjana embraces Maruti's new name, Hanuman, while Lord Shiva explains its significance to Mata Parvati. Meanwhile, Devi Anjana grows concerned about Hanuman's newfound powers.

episodesList.title: Doodh Abhishek
episodesList.summary: Devi Anjana grows anxious as there's no milk for Lord Shiva's abhishek. Meanwhile, Maruti tries to understand his newfound powers. Later, he sings his mother's favourite raag, miraculously healing all the cows in Anjanadri.

episodesList.title: Maruti Arrives In Kishkindha
episodesList.summary: Maruti and Maharaj Kesari arrive in Kishkindha and are captivated by the lively haat. Later, Maruti presents a special gift to Bali at the Akhada. Meanwhile, a concerned Devi Anjana also travels to Kishkindha, worried about Maruti.

episodesList.title: Kshama Ya Dand?
episodesList.summary: Just as Bali prepares to kill the bull for injuring the king, Maruti intervenes. Raja Kesari finds himself torn between upholding his dharma and honoring his son's plea. Will Maruti succeed in saving the bull?

episodesList.title: Sansaar Ki Sahayta
episodesList.summary: Raja Kesari is assigned the task of slaying the bull to uphold justice, but Maruti frees the bull before it can happen. Meanwhile, Bali and others accuse Maruti of committing Raj Droh in front of Devi Anjana.

episodesList.title: Sanghar Ka Aadesh
episodesList.summary: Maharaj Vrikshraj recovers and speaks to the gathering about the attack. Bali feels dejected by the Maharaj's decision against him. Later, Maruti visits the Gurukul with his parents.

episodesList.title: Gurukul Prasthan
episodesList.summary: Maruti seeks his parents' blessings before beginning his journey at the Gurukul. There, he meets Sugriva, mistaking him for Bali. Meanwhile, Bali forms an alliance with an asur.

episodesList.title: Buddhi Ki Pariksha
episodesList.summary: It's Maruti's first day at the Gurukul, and he quickly wins over his guru with his brilliance. Later, he visits Maharishi Matanga. Meanwhile, Bali and the Asur hatch a plan to attack him.

episodesList.title: Aashirwaad Ka Kavach
episodesList.summary: Devi Anjana offers prayers to the Gods for Maruti's well-being ahead of his birthday. Meanwhile, Acharya Madhusudhan visits the Gurukul and assigns a small task to the students. Later, Bali arrives bearing gifts for Maruti.

episodesList.title: Maruti Faces Kaaldant
episodesList.summary: Kaaldant stands in Maruti's path, challenging him and obstructing his journey to attain the Arima Siddhi. Meanwhile, Marutis's friends are captured and call out for his help. Will Maruti overcome Kaaldant and save his friends?

episodesList.title: Chote Hone Ke Fayde Aur Nuksaan
episodesList.summary: Bali is upset to learn that Maruti is unharmed and that Kaaldant has been defeated. Meanwhile, Maruti begins to explore his Anima Siddhi but ends up trapped inside a tiny water droplet. Later, Devi Anjana grows worried and starts searching for him.

episodesList.title: Patal Kali Ka Krodh
episodesList.summary: Devi Anjana searches for Maruti as Bali's men also close in on him. While Maruti attempts to reach his mother, Bali captures him. Meanwhile, Patal Kali learns of Kaaldant's defeat and vows to punish Maruti.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ki Yatra Aur Niyati
episodesList.summary: Maruti finds himself trapped inside a box and struggles to break free. Meanwhile, Devi Anjana prays earnestly to Lord Shiva for his protection. Will Maruti manage to escape?

episodesList.title: Abhyaas Se Prerna Lena
episodesList.summary: Maruti tries to call out to his mother, but his tiny size makes him inaudible. Meanwhile, Devi Anjana prepares his favorite ladoos, hoping they'll lead her to him. Will her love and prayers help her find her son?

episodesList.title: Maruti Par Vipada
episodesList.summary: Maruti reunites with Devi Anjana and shares everything he experienced, seeking her guidance on returning to his original size. Later, Vayu Dev arrives to meet Devi Anjana and tells her about Patal Kali's curse on Maruti.

episodesList.title: Devi Anjana In Patal Lok
episodesList.summary: Devi Anjana approaches Patal Kali to seek forgiveness on Maruti's behalf, while Maruti searches for his mother. Later, she comes face-to-face with Patal Kali. Will the goddess forgive Maruti?

episodesList.title: Mata Sabkuch Hain
episodesList.summary: Maruti impresses his Guru by speaking fondly of his mother. Meanwhile, Raja Kesari summons the vaid, concerned for Devi Anjana's well-being. Will Devi Anjana end up surrendering her soul to Patal Kali?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ka Raudra Roop
episodesList.summary: Maruti is devastated to find his mother unconscious and, in his distress, unleashes such chaos that the Devtas grow increasingly concerned. Determined to save her, he sets off to Patal Lok to confront Patal Kali.

episodesList.title: Prakriti Ki Sahayta
episodesList.summary: Following Vayu Dev's advice, Maruti ventures into Patal Lok to rescue his mother. Meanwhile, Raja Kesari grows concerned as he notices Devi Anjana's feet turning yellow. In Patal Lok, Maruti hears the cry of a little girl.

episodesList.title: Maruti Rescues The Girl
episodesList.summary: Maruti rescues the girl from Ahiravan's men, while Raja Kesari searches for the jadibooti to heal Devi Anjana. Will Maruti succeed in reaching Patal Kali?

episodesList.title: Maa Anjana Ka Putra
episodesList.summary: The ghosts of Patal Lok surround Maruti, but he bravely fights them off alone. Meanwhile, Raja Kesari gets injured. Later, Maruti pleads with Patal Kali to spare his mother.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Hone Ka Pramaan
episodesList.summary: Maruti vows to Patal Kali that he will prevent the sunrise, while Raja Kesari prays to Lord Shiva for Devi Anjana's protection. Using his Mahima Siddhi, Maruti stops the sun's rays from reaching Earth.

episodesList.title: Maruti Ke Charitra Ki Mahaanta
episodesList.summary: Patal Kali is moved by Maruti's dedication to saving his mother, and Devi Anjana finally regains consciousness. Later, Maruti begins to understand the true meaning of having an Aradhya.

episodesList.title: Aradhya Ka Matlab
episodesList.summary: Vayu Dev shares with Devi Anjana the lengths Maruti went to in order to bring her back to life, while Maruti learns the true meaning of having an Aradhya. Meanwhile, preparations begin in Kishkindha to welcome Veer Hanuman.

episodesList.title: Aradhya Ki Khoj
episodesList.summary: Maruti immerses himself in deep meditation to discover the name of his Aradhya, while his friends enjoy their meal. Meanwhile, Sugriva faces a challenge from Dadhimukha that he can only marry Roma once he becomes the Yuvraj.

episodesList.title: Ashubh Sanket
episodesList.summary: Maruti and his friends set out in search of Jatayu. Meanwhile, Shani Dev arrives in Kishkindha. Later, the Asurs reach Kishkindha, carrying a message from Ahiravan in Patal Lok.

episodesList.title: Dadhimukha's Deceit
episodesList.summary: Dadhimukha deceives Maruti and his friends by handing them over to Ahiravan's men. However, Maruti bravely rescues his friends and escapes from Patal Lok. Later, he wholeheartedly accepts Jatayu as his Guru.

episodesList.title: Aradhya Ki Jyot
episodesList.summary: Maruti finally discovers the name of his Aradhya and joyfully chants it aloud. Meanwhile, Raja Kesari and Maharaj Rikshraj begin discussions about who will be the future king of Kishkindha. Later, Maruti boldly challenges Bali to a duel.

episodesList.title: Eshwar Prem Mein Hain
episodesList.summary: Maruti risks his life to save a goat and meets Shani Dev, who is in disguise as a rishi. Later, he bravely fights off some asurs to rescue his friend.

episodesList.title: Asuro Ke Saath Jung
episodesList.summary: Maruti and his friends celebrate after defeating the asurs. Meanwhile, in court, Sugriva advises against going to war, concerned about its impact on the people but Bali disagrees. Later, Bali learns that the asurs have united to attack Kishkindha.

episodesList.title: Jeevan Jyoti Patra
episodesList.summary: Maruti learns about Rishi Tathastu through his disciple and vows to help him by retrieving the Jeevan Jyoti Patra. Meanwhile, a war is declared in Kishkindha. Later, Maruti faces off against a powerful Yaksh.

episodesList.title: Maruti In Yaksh Lok
episodesList.summary: Neil informs Devi Anjana that Maruti has gone to Yaksh Lok to retrieve the Jeevan Jyoti Patra, prompting her to pray to Lord Shiva for his protection. Later, Lord Kuber arrives to help Maruti on his journey.

episodesList.title: Maruti Ka Aatmaball
episodesList.summary: Maruti earns the Vayu Gada for his bravery and regains his Siddhis. Meanwhile, Sugriva is captured by Mayavi Asur, who demands Bali to surrender his weapon. Later, Maruti hands over the Jeevan Jyoti Patra to Rishi Tathastu, freeing him from his curse.

episodesList.title: Dhwand Ki Goonj
episodesList.summary: Maruti returns to Kishkindha only to find the citizens injured from the war with the asurs, and he's blamed for it. Meanwhile, Mayavi retreats after his army loses to Bali. Later, Marutis friends end their friendship with him.

episodesList.title: Sandhay Ki Chhaya
episodesList.summary: Raja Kesari and Devi Anjana have a disagreement over Maruti accepting Bali as his Aradhya. Maruti then joins Raja Kesari on his visit to Kishkindha, where he is scolded by the court members who hold him responsible for the recent chaos. Later, Maharaj Rikshraj declares Sugriva as the new Yuvraj of Kishkindha.

episodesList.title: Bali Ki Peeda
episodesList.summary: Maruti joins his friends to play, but they ignore him. Meanwhile, Bali prays to Lord Shiva, expressing his frustration over not being made King. Later, an asur abducts Maruti's friend Nal.

episodesList.title: Mitrata Ki Saugandh
episodesList.summary: Maruti heads to Chhayanagri in search of his friend Nal and discovers the asur behind the chaos. Meanwhile, Lord Shiva warns Shani Dev about Hanuman's rising power. Will Hanuman succeed in rescuing his friend?

episodesList.title: Tamohghat Ki Gufa
episodesList.summary: Hanuman arrives at Tamohghat's cave and attempts to interrupt his yagya. Meanwhile, Mayavi teams up with Ahiravan to bring down Bali. Later, Bali relinquishes his position and chooses to step away from the battle against the asurs.

episodesList.title: Kishkindha Par Hamla
episodesList.summary: Hanuman confronts Tamohghat, all while being concerned about the looming attack on Kishkindha. Meanwhile, Sugriva rallies his forces to face the asurs. Later, Mayavi, disguised as Raja Kesari, launches an attack on Maharaj Rikshraj.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Gets Trapped
episodesList.summary: Hanuman gets caught in Tamohghat's trap while Nal faces danger. Meanwhile, Maharaj Rikshraj questions Bali's absence. Later, through his unwavering devotion to Shri Ram, Hanuman overcomes Tamohghat.

episodesList.title: Kishkindha Ka Naya Yuvraj
episodesList.summary: Hanuman and Raja Kesari defeat Mayavi in battle. Meanwhile, an asur manages to steal the granth that Devi Anjana had carefully safeguarded. Later, Bali is declared the new Yuvraj of Kishkindha.

episodesList.title: Kesari Ji Ki Bhool
episodesList.summary: The sacred Granth is stolen, and Raja Kesari is held responsible for its loss. Determined to restore his father's honour, Hanuman sets out to track down the asur behind the theft. Meanwhile, Hanuman begins to sense something odd that Shani Dev seems to appear at every place where danger strikes.

episodesList.title: Putra Ki Peeda
episodesList.summary: Hanuman confronts Shani Dev. Meanwhile, Devi Anjana firmly tells Dadhimukha that she will not leave Kishkindha with her family. Later, Hanuman is left helpless as he tries to revive his unconscious father.

episodesList.title: Prakriti Ka Prakop
episodesList.summary: Maharaj Rikshraj is deeply concerned for his people, while Hanuman mourns the loss of his father. Determined to bring him back to life, Hanuman embarks on a quest to find the sacred granth

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ki Sachhi Bhakti
episodesList.summary: Hanuman resolves to retrieve the Granth and save his father, but Devi Anjana urges him not to leave. Defying her wishes, Hanuman journeys to Patal Lok, where he battles Mayavi and his army

episodesList.title: Mayavi Ka Jaal
episodesList.summary: Hanuman falls into Mayavi's trap as Raja Kesari fights for his life. Before Hanuman can return the Granth to save his father, Ahirawan stands in his way.

episodesList.title: Devi Anjana Ka Vachan
episodesList.summary: Hanuman suggests that Jamvant Ji be entrusted with the Granth. Meanwhile, Devi Anjana prepares to leave, keeping her promise to Brahma Dev. Later, Hanuman sets out in search of Shani Dev

episodesList.title: Hanuman Catches Shani Dev
episodesList.summary: Hanuman captures Shani Dev and attempts to expose him, but is confronted by Sugriva. Meanwhile, Devi Anjana begins her Yagya.

episodesList.title: Shani Dev Ka Uddeshya
episodesList.summary: Hanuman saves a man from falling off a cliff and cares for his injuries. The man confesses that he stole a ring from Shri Ram in Ayodhya. Later, Hanuman sets out to find Shani Dev.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ki Yojana
episodesList.summary: Hanuman confronts Shani Dev and manages to capture him. But in retaliation, Shani Dev unleashes chaos across Kishkindha with his powers. Can Hanuman rise to the challenge and save Kishkindha?

episodesList.title: Hanuman's Pledge
episodesList.summary: As Devi Anjana continues her Yagya, Hanuman vows to capture Shani Dev once more. Sugriva steps in, trying to calm him, but Hanuman soon finds himself facing the full force of Shani Dev's wrath.

episodesList.title: Shani Ki Shakti
episodesList.summary: Hanuman and Shani Dev clash in a fierce battle, while Devi Anjana prepares for her journey to Brahma Lok. Can Hanuman overcome Shani Dev's power and save his mother before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Shani Dev Ki Peeda
episodesList.summary: Hanuman bids a heartfelt farewell to Devi Anjana. Later, he cares for an injured Shani Dev, who, moved by Hanuman's compassion, makes him a solemn promise.

episodesList.title: Maa Ka Aanchal
episodesList.summary: An emotional Hanuman misses Devi Anjana and tries to console his grieving father. Bali and Sugriva visit him and gently remind him that Devi Anjana cannot return. Later, Hanuman sets out for Ayodhya to meet his aradhya, Shri Ram.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ki Pukaar
episodesList.summary: As Hanuman longs to meet Shri Ram, Indra Dev tells Lord Shiva he plans to test him first. Will Hanuman reach his aradhya?

episodesList.title: Prabhu Ka Naam Jap
episodesList.summary: As Hanuman recalls his aradhya, Lord Shiva appears in disguise to test his devotion. Will the bhakt finally unite with his bhagwan?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ka Anurodh
episodesList.summary: Hanuman seeks Bhola's help to enter Ayodhya and bring his mother back. Will Lord Shiva, in disguise, aid him, or will the Devtas stand in his way?

episodesList.title: Mann Ki Tripti
episodesList.summary: Hanuman prepares and serves food to Bhola. Later, as hunger strikes Hanuman, Indra Dev's plan keeps food away from him. Will Lord Shiva come to his rescue?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ke Liye Bhojan Ki Thali
episodesList.summary: Shri Ram sends a thali for Hanuman, but he doubts its origin. Soon after, Hanuman falls off a cliff.

episodesList.title: Rajkiya Utsav
episodesList.summary: As Hanuman and Bhola prepare for the Rajkiya Utsav, Bhola places yet another challenge in Hanuman's path while he searches for Kausalya Mata. Will Hanuman finally reach his aradhya, Shri Ram?

episodesList.title: Sundarta Aur Sugandh
episodesList.summary: Bhola sends Hanuman on a quest to find a garland for Shri Ram, but Indra Dev plots to stop him. Meanwhile, Bhola reaches the court and meets Shri Ram. Will Hanuman fulfill his task in time?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Enters Ayodhya
episodesList.summary: Hanuman finally steps into Ayodhya to meet Shri Ram. As Shri Ram distributes prasad amidst a gathering crowd, will Hanuman be able to reach his aradhya?

episodesList.title: Bhakt Aur Bhagwan Ka Milan
episodesList.summary: Hanuman finally meets his aradhya, Shri Ram, in a divine moment witnessed by all. As he prepares to offer his special gift, Bhola unveils a plan of his own.

episodesList.title: Prabhu Ka Ashwasan
episodesList.summary: Hanuman believes Devi Anjana will return, trusting Shri Ram's word. Meanwhile, the Devtas question Lord Shiv. Will Hanuman truly reunite with his mother?

episodesList.title: Vishesh Pushp
episodesList.summary: Disguised as merchants, the Devtas tell Hanuman he must fetch the flowers to deliver the itra to Shri Ram. Meanwhile, Shri Ram begins searching for Hanuman.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ka Vishwas
episodesList.summary: While Hanuman seeks flowers for Shri Ram's Itra, he encounters a demon snake. Meanwhile, Bhola confronts Shri Ram in Ayodhya. Will Hanuman succeed in his quest?

episodesList.title: Paap Ka Ant
episodesList.summary: When the demon snake breaks his promise, Hanuman steps in to teach him a lesson. Meanwhile, the Devtas prepare their next move against him.

episodesList.title: Parishram Aur Aastha
episodesList.summary: Bhola informs Hanuman that Shri Ram was looking for him, while Shri Ram injures his feet. Meanwhile, the Devtas poison the itra meant to reach Shri Ram through Hanuman. How will Hanuman handle this threat?

episodesList.title: Itra Mein Vish
episodesList.summary: Hanuman learns the itra meant for Shri Ram is poisoned and confronts the Devtas. Can he reach in time to save his aradhya?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ka Acharan
episodesList.summary: To protect Shri Ram, Hanuman pours the poisoned itra on himself. Later, he and Bhola are captured by Shri Ram's guards.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Par Ilzaam
episodesList.summary: Shri Ram questions his guards for capturing Bhola and Hanuman, while Manthara accuses Hanuman of plotting to harm him with poisoned itra. How will Shri Ram respond to this serious allegation?

episodesList.title: Indra Dev Ka Chakravaat
episodesList.summary: As Hanuman approaches Shri Ram to share his troubles, Indra Dev sets his next plan in motion. How will Hanuman face this new challenge?

episodesList.title: Do Shaktiyon Ka Divya Milan
episodesList.summary: Hanuman seeks Shri Ram's blessings and sets out to face the thunderstorm unleashed by Indra Dev. With Ayodhya in turmoil, will he save it in time with Shri Ram by his side?

episodesList.title: Bhakti Ka Dhong
episodesList.summary: Bharat collapses underground and lies unconscious, while Hanuman sets out to confront Indra Dev. Will he save Ayodhya?

episodesList.title: Shri Ram Ka Sachha Bhakt
episodesList.summary: Bhola steps in to ease tensions between Hanuman and Indra Dev. But with Hanuman's fury at its peak, will Indra Dev bow down and apologise?

episodesList.title: Shri Ram Ka Niradar
episodesList.summary: Hanuman confronts a soldier from Kashi Raj for insulting Shri Ram, but Lakshman urges him to step back and apologise. Will Hanuman hold his ground or follow Lakshman's advice?

episodesList.title: Ram Ratan Dhan Payo
episodesList.summary: Hanuman turns insult into devotion by praising Shri Ram, as Lakshman defends him. Later, Lakshman invites Hanuman for a bhoj with his aradhya, Shri Ram.

episodesList.title: Dhaal Ki Bhet
episodesList.summary: Hanuman faces delays as Indra Dev creates obstacles in making the shield. Meanwhile, Shri Ram confronts Bharat for insulting Manthara. With the bhoj approaching, will Hanuman reach on time?

episodesList.title: Hanuman's Devotion
episodesList.summary: Moved by Hanuman's devotion, Agni Dev, disguised as a blacksmith, helps him forge the shield. Later, Hanuman reaches the palace for the bhoj with Shri Ram. Will his questions finally find answers?

episodesList.title: Shri Ram Ki Uljhan
episodesList.summary: Hanuman asks Shri Ram why his mother hasn't returned from Malay Parvat despite his assurance. Shri Ram begins his search for an answer. Will he find a way to help Hanuman?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ki Shraddha Aur Vishwas
episodesList.summary: Bhola and Hanuman go their separate ways. Meanwhile, as Shri Ram visits his guru in search of answers for Hanuman, the Asurs capture him. Can Hanuman rescue his aradhya?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Gets Blamed
episodesList.summary: While Manthara accuses Hanuman of Shri Ram's disappearance, Bharat, Shatrughan, and Lakshman stand firmly by him. Meanwhile, Shri Ram fights to protect the rishis. Can Hanuman reach in time to save his aradhya?

episodesList.title: Panchtatvo Ka Marg
episodesList.summary: Shri Ram battles Kastasur in a fierce sword fight, while Hanuman invokes the Panchatatva to reach his aradhya. Will he arrive in time to save Shri Ram?

episodesList.title: Kastasur Ka Ant
episodesList.summary: With Agnidev's help, Hanuman defeats Kastasur while Shri Ram saves the rishis. Later, feeling Ayodhya no longer needs him, Hanuman chooses not to meet Shri Ram.

episodesList.title: Shri Ram Reunites With His Mother
episodesList.summary: Shri Ram reunites with his mother, leading Mata Kaikeyi to regret doubting Hanuman's devotion. Meanwhile, Tataka mourns Subahu's injury and begins plotting her revenge.

episodesList.title: Praja Ka Dukh
episodesList.summary: As Subahu sets a trap and a new danger approaches Ayodhya, Shri Ram faces the challenge alone in Hanuman's absence. Will he be able to protect his kingdom?

episodesList.title: Lakshman Reprimands Hanuman
episodesList.summary: As Tataka prepares to take revenge on Hanuman, Subahu tries to caution her. Meanwhile, Lakshman scolds Hanuman for disrespecting Shri Ram. How will Hanuman react to Lakshman's rebuke?

episodesList.title: Raj Vaidya Falgun Ki Khoj
episodesList.summary: Mata Kaikeyi shares with Shri Ram the story of the war against the asurs and how Raj Vaidya Falgun was sent away from Ayodhya. At the same time, Tataka plans her revenge and captures Hanuman. How will Hanuman protect Ayodhya now?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Fights Tataka
episodesList.summary: Hanuman faces Tataka as she tries to place the entire blame on Raj Vaidya Falgun. With Ayodhya waiting for the cure, will Hanuman be able to bring Raj Vaidya Falgun back with him?

episodesList.title: Shri Ram Ka Pran
episodesList.summary: Shri Ram vows to leave Ayodhya if he cannot find answers to Hanuman's questions. Later, Lakshman shares Shri Ram's decision with Hanuman. Will Hanuman be able to make him change his mind?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ke Sawal Ka Jawab
episodesList.summary: Shri Ram guides Hanuman towards finding his answers as Brahma Dev appears before him. Later, Lord Shiva speaks of a looming danger heading towards Kishkindha.

episodesList.title: Rajneeti Aur Malla
episodesList.summary: Hanuman rescues a group of women from the asurs. Meanwhile, Indra Dev approaches Bali and urges him to defeat Ravan. What will Bali plan next?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ka Uddeshya
episodesList.summary: Hanuman is caught between helping the asurs and rescuing his mother from Malay Parvat. Meanwhile, Maharaj Kesari urges Bali to give up his plan to defeat Ravan. Later, Brahma Dev places a condition before Devi Anjana.

episodesList.title: Putra Viyog Ki Peeda
episodesList.summary: Indra Dev sets a trap for Devi Anjana, but Bhola reaches just in time to save her and confront him. Meanwhile, Bali learns that Hanuman must go to Surya Lok to gain knowledge. Will Devi Anjana allow him to go?

episodesList.title: Mata Aur Putra Ka Milan
episodesList.summary: Maruti reunites with Devi Anjana, but his thoughts remain with the grieving villagers he left behind who were asking for help. Meanwhile, Bali informs Indra Dev about Hanuman's journey to Surya Lok. What will Indra Dev do next?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Returns To Kishkindha
episodesList.summary: Hanuman returns to Kishkindha and receives a grand welcome along with Devi Anjana. As he begins to spread the name of Shri Ram, he faces resistance from the people and Maharaj Kesari, who stop him from waving Ayodhya's flag. How will Hanuman convince his father?

episodesList.title: Dharm Ki Pataka
episodesList.summary: Hanuman searches for Shri Ram's flag but is unable to find it, leading to frustration and destruction. How will the people of Kishkindha face Hanuman's growing anger?

episodesList.title: Uchit Aur Anuchit Ka Bhed
episodesList.summary: While Hanuman asks for forgiveness, Bali takes it as an act of treason and demands that Hanuman be punished. Later, Bhola advises Hanuman to begin his journey of learning under Surya Dev. But as Hanuman sets out on this new path, what obstacles will he face next?

episodesList.title: Surya Dev Ka Krodh
episodesList.summary: As Hanuman reaches Surya Lok, Devi Sangya confronts Surya Dev. Meanwhile, Hanuman struggles to get an audience with the divine teacher. Will Surya Dev acknowledge Hanuman and agree to guide him?

episodesList.title: Pratishodh Ki Maleenta
episodesList.summary: Hanuman arrives at Surya Lok and humbly asks Surya Dev to accept him as his student. But Surya Dev dismisses him with arrogance and speaks ill of Shri Ram. How will Hanuman react to this insult?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ka Apmaan
episodesList.summary: Surya Dev agrees to teach Hanuman but only if he gives up his devotion to Shri Ram. Later, Hanuman faces mockery and insults from the people of Surya Lok. How will he deal with it?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ne Kiya Bal Ka Prayog
episodesList.summary: Hanuman reprimands Arun Dev for his behaviour, leading Surya Dev to ask him to leave Surya Lok. But Hanuman stands his ground and calls Surya Dev arrogant. How will Surya Dev react to this bold confrontation?

episodesList.title: Krodh Ki Jwalamukhi
episodesList.summary: Surya Dev warns Hanuman about the consequences of his actions. Later, Devi Sangya tries to calm him down and comes up with a plan to teach Hanuman a lesson. What is she planning?

episodesList.title: Yug Ka Sabse Bada Surya Grahan
episodesList.summary: As Rahu performs the Surya Grahan, Hanuman interrupts him following Devi Sangya's instructions. Later, Indra Dev confronts Hanuman for crossing his limits. Will there be consequences for Hanuman?

episodesList.title: Surya Dev Ne Maangi Maafi
episodesList.summary: As Hanuman clashes with Indra Dev in a fierce battle, Brahma Dev arrives and intervenes. At the same time, Bali lashes out at Sugriva for defying him. Later, Brahma Dev rebukes Surya Dev and instructs him to apologise to Rahu.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ka Tyaag
episodesList.summary: After Hanuman apologises, Surya Dev asks him to give up his Siddhis as a condition. Will Surya Dev finally agree to become his teacher?

episodesList.title: Agya Ki Avelna
episodesList.summary: Hanuman opens the gates of Surya Lok for Devi Chhaya, who had been exiled. In response, Surya Dev decides to punish him and banishes him to Asurya Lok. How will Hanuman cope with this decision?

episodesList.title: Hanuman In Asurya Lok
episodesList.summary: After being banished to Asurya Lok, Hanuman finds himself in a twisted version of Kishkindha. How will he navigate a world where his deepest fears come to life?

episodesList.title: Maya Ka Andhkar
episodesList.summary: Surya Dev and Indra Dev mislead Hanuman into making the wrong choices in Asurya Lok while he tries to protect Sugriva from his father's anger. What consequences will Hanuman face now?

episodesList.title: Bhakti Ka Bal
episodesList.summary: Surya Dev makes Indra Dev realise that he has been defeated by Hanuman. Meanwhile, Hanuman bravely faces the asurs in Asurya Lok. Later, Surya Dev acknowledges Hanuman's devotion and finally accepts him with pride.

episodesList.title: Sarvochya Gyaan Prapti Ki Yatra
episodesList.summary: Surya Dev accepts Hanuman as his student and takes the name of Shri Ram. Later, Hanuman meets Devi Chhaya and promises to restore her place in Surya Lok. Will Surya Dev honour this promise, or will Hanuman face a new challenge in keeping his word?

episodesList.title: Devi Chhaya In Surya Lok
episodesList.summary: Hanuman takes Devi Chhaya to Surya Lok, which angers Surya Dev as Hanuman stands against him. How will Hanuman face Surya Dev and reveal the truth?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Takes On Yam Dev
episodesList.summary: Indra Dev urges Devi Chhaya to return to Surya Lok, while Devi Sangya feels insulted and Yam Dev plans to punish Hanuman. Will Surya Dev intervene?

episodesList.title: Nyaay Ka Roop
episodesList.summary: As Devi Sangya prepares to curse Hanuman, Devi Chhaya steps in. Later, Surya Dev gives Hanuman one last chance to prove her innocence. Will Hanuman succeed?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Ka Nimantran
episodesList.summary: Hanuman gathers everyone to reveal the truth about Devi Sangya and Surya Dev. Will he succeed or face Surya Dev's punishment?

episodesList.title: Shani Dev Arrives In Surya Lok
episodesList.summary: Shani Dev arrives in Surya Lok, unsettling Devi Sangya. Hanuman seeks his help to restore Devi Chhaya's place there. How will Surya Dev respond?

episodesList.title: Bheetar Ka Bhay
episodesList.summary: Devi Chhaya assumes Devi Sangya's place in Surya Lok, while Devi Sangya struggles to return from Asurya Lok. Will Surya Dev find out?

episodesList.title: Devi Sangya Ka Sach
episodesList.summary: Devi Chhaya and Devi Sangya come face to face before Surya Dev, each revealing her true identity. How will Surya Dev respond to this truth?

episodesList.title: Surya Dev Ke Gyaan Ka Prakash
episodesList.summary: As Hanuman learns under Surya Dev's guidance, Bali vents his anger to Indra Dev. Will their plotting create new hurdles in Hanuman's path?

episodesList.title: Dashanan Ka Yagya
episodesList.summary: To gain more power, Ravan captures Shani Dev and tries to take control of the nine planets. Can Hanuman stop him in time?

episodesList.title: Ravan Ki Bhakti
episodesList.summary: As Hanuman finishes his education with Surya Dev, Shani Dev reveals his presence to Ravan. Furious, Ravan sets out for Kailash to confront Lord Shiv. What storm will this bring?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Returns To Kishkindha
episodesList.summary: Hanuman returns to Kishkindha and is welcomed with great joy. Later, Maharaj Rikshraj honours him by appointing him to his council. But how will Bali respond to Hanuman's rising importance?

episodesList.title: Dadhimukh Ki Chaal
episodesList.summary: Hanuman and his friends are attacked by wild animals sent by Dadhimukh. At the same time, Sugriva faces a deadly assault. Will Hanuman be able to protect them both?

episodesList.title: Kishkindha Ki Suraksha
episodesList.summary: Hanuman discovers the asurs and drives them away, sending them back to Ravan. Meanwhile, Sugriva prepares a strategy to safeguard Kishkindha. How will Ravan strike in retaliation?

episodesList.title: Kishkindha Par Ravan Ka Hamla
episodesList.summary: Hanuman confronts Dadhimukh for sending animals to attack him and his friends. Meanwhile, the asur sena launches an attack on Kishkindha but Maharaj Kesari stops Hanuman from joining the battle.

episodesList.title: Lord Shiva Meets Hanuman
episodesList.summary: Ravan tries to overpower Bali but fails. Meanwhile, Hanuman seeks guidance from Bhola, who tells him to stop Bali from finishing Ravan. How will Hanuman manage it?

episodesList.title: Bali Ki Jeet
episodesList.summary: Hanuman smartly convinces Bali to spare Ravan's life and instead spread the tale of his victory to prove his strength. Later, as Hanuman begins spreading the glory of Shri Ram, Ravan secretly plots to join forces with Bali.

episodesList.title: Bali Takes On Sugriva
episodesList.summary: Bali confronts Sugriva for supporting Hanuman in praising Shri Ram and agrees to Dadhimukh's proposal of marriage. Later, when Bali and Sugriva clash in a fierce battle, Hanuman steps in to intervene.

episodesList.title: Mallayuddha
episodesList.summary: Hanuman defeats Bali in the Mallayuddha when Maharaj Rikshraj steps in. Later, Indra Dev tries to calm Bali. Will Bali allow Sugriva and Ruma's wedding?

episodesList.title: Chal Aur Chaal
episodesList.summary: Bali joins hands with Ravan to keep Hanuman away from his wedding with Ruma. Meanwhile, Hanuman's friends cry out for help. Will Hanuman be able to rescue them and put an end to Bali and Ruma's wedding?

episodesList.title: Adharmi Ki Drishti
episodesList.summary: With Lord Shiva's blessings, Hanuman defeats Kalkasur and ensures that Sugriva and Ruma's marriage takes place. How will Bali react to this turn of events?

episodesList.title: Sugriva And Ruma's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Sugriva and Ruma thank Hanuman for uniting them in marriage. Meanwhile, Bali plots his next move against Hanuman when Maharaj Rikshraj steps in to confront him.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Confronts Bali
episodesList.summary: Bali feels betrayed and cries out to Lord Shiva for answers. Meanwhile, Hanuman scolds his friends for distracting him from his path. Later, Ravan manipulates Bali by revealing a way through which Rishi Durvasa could curse Hanuman.

episodesList.title: Rishi Durvasa Ka Shraap
episodesList.summary: Hanuman fights off a giant snake to protect Rishi Durvasa, but the rishi's meditation is disturbed and he curses Hanuman. How will Hanuman face this curse?

episodesList.title: Ravan Ka Khel
episodesList.summary: Ravan, humiliated by Bali, seeks revenge. Meanwhile, Hanuman immerses himself in the devotion of Shri Ram. How will Ravan stop him?

episodesList.title: Dharm Ki Raksha
episodesList.summary: While the entire Kishkindha falls under possession, Hanuman continues to meditate on Shri Ram's name. Later, Lord Shiva commands him to rise, take up his weapons, and save Kishkindha from the clutches of Krityasur.

plotHtml: The series chronicles the journey of Lord Hanuman from his childhood as Maruti to becoming a symbol of unwavering devotion and supernatural strength. Set in the mythical kingdom of Kishkindha, the story follows young Maruti as he gradually uncovers his divine identity. Guided by his parents and spiritual mentors, he embarks on a journey that brings him into contact with various deities and key figures from Hindu mythology. The show emphasizes Hanuman’s internal evolution, focusing on devotion, humility, valor, and the virtues that make him the ideal devotee of Lord Rama.
tagline: The series chronicles the journey of Lord Hanuman from his childhood as Maruti to becoming a symbol of unwavering devotion and supernatural strength.

title: Vera Maari Trip
summary:
Vera Maari Trip (transl. Different Trip) is a 2025 Indian Tamil-language workplace comedy sitcom streaming television series directed by RJ Shivakanth for Aha Tamil. The series created and written by RJ Shivakanth, and starring Jaiseelan, Raveena Daha, Vishwa Mithran, Sapna, VJ Pappu, Padine Kumar, Nizhalgal Ravi, Vikkals Vikram, Kureshi, Vanvi, Shiva Shah Ra, Vinoth and Nana Saravanan.
It was released on Aha Tamil on 9 January 2025, and is available for streaming on Aha Tamil in selected regions.

title: Vasudha
summary: Vasudha is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that premiered from 16 September 2024 on Zee TV. It is produced by Arvind Babbal. The series is an official remake of the Telugu TV series Muddha Mandaram of Zee Telugu. It stars Priya Thakur, and Abhishek Sharma in lead roles.
plot: Vasudha, a happy-go-lucky maid, joins business leader Chandrika's home. Despite their ideological differences, she seeks Chandrika's approval and struggles to fit into her elite world.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Priya Thakur as Vasudha "Vasu" Solanki: Hanumant's daughter; Raghu's sister; Devansh's wife (2024–present) * Abhishek Sharma as Devansh Dev Singh Chauhan: Chandrika and Prabhat's elder son; Avinash's brother; Vasudha's husband (2024–present)

articleSections.text: Ayushi Khurana as Reet Chaudhary from Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile (2025) * Bharat Ahlawat as Raghav Suryavanshi from Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile (2025) * Jayati Bhatia as Sharda Suryavanshi from Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile * Sehaj Rajput as Unnati Chaudhary from Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile (2025) * Rohit Dhiman as Dhruv Chaudhary from Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile (2025) * Samaksh Sudi as Virendra Suryavanshi from Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile (2025) * Kalpana Sisodia as Poonam Suryavanshi from Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile (2025) * Rohan Rai as Pratik Suryavanshi from Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile (2025) * Divya Choudhary as Divya Suryavanshi from Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile (2025) * Shalini Ramchandran as Neeta Chawla from Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile (2025) * Sonakshi Batra as Jagadhatri "JD" Naik from Jagadhatri (2026)

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Abhishek Sharma was signed to play male lead, Devansh "Dev" Singh Chauhan. Kunwar Vikram Soni was confirmed to play Madhav. Nausheen Ali Sardar joined the cast as Chandrika, marking her television comeback after 2 years. In April 2025, Pratiksha Rai was selected to play Karishma. In same month, Rajesh Jais was cast as Surya Singh Rathod. In July 2025, Sardar quit the series and replaced by Parineeta Borthakur. In October 2025 three people are join the cast Puneet Sachdev as Karanveer, Ankita Bahuguna as Vidhi Singh and Nishi Saxena as Nandini.
In March 2026, Kiran Bhargava joined the cast. Later May Parichay Sharma entered the show as Samar Sisodia

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text:
After initially averaging a 0.9–1.1 TRP, Vasudha surged to 1.5 TRP in July 2025. The show climbed further to 1.7 TRP, eventually reaching a peak TRP of 2.0 in May 2026.

title: Valliyin Velan
summary: Valliyin Velan is an Indian Tamil language television series that premiered from 2 September 2024 to 25 May 2025 on Zee Tamil. It is produced by John Attaikulam, directed by Prathap Mani / V. Sadhasivam and it stars the real couple Shreya Anchan and Sidhu Sid. The story revolves around an innocent young girl Valli from wealthy family, who has been waiting for years to get the love of her father. It is the remake of Zee Telugu's Ammayi Garu.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Shreya Anchan as Valli: Rathinavel Pandiyan & Janaki's only one daughter & Kadhirvelan's wife (2024–2025) * Sidhu Sid as Kadhirvelan / Sakthivel: Rathinavel Pandiyan's aide-turned-Son-in-law & Valli's husband (2024–2025) * Saakshi Siva (2024) / Sridhar (2024–2025) / Girish (2025) as Rathinavel Pandiyan: Valli's father, Janaki's husband, Vedhanayagi's younger brother, Kathivelan's uncle & Kadhirvelan's Father-in-law

articleSections.title: Special Appearances
articleSections.text: Shyam Viswanathan * Anjana Sreenivasan as Inspector Durga * Ineya as Governor

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The show was produced by John Attaikulam under the Yatra Media Works. It was second collaboration with Zee Tamil after Kanaa serial. It was directed by Prathap Mani and V. Sadhasivam.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Shreya Anchan was cast as Valli and This series the mark comeback Shreya after one years hiatus on TV and also it was second collaboration with Zee Tamil after Rajini serial. And also this is the second series where the duo will be acting together after the Thirumanam series. Saakshi Siva and Kanya Bharathi was selected to play Rathinavel Pandiyan and Vedhanayagi.
On 20 March 2025, actress Ineya was brought in for special appearances as Governor.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The makers released the first official Launch Promo for Valliyin Velan on 7 August 2024, which gave a brief insight in Valli's background story. The second promo was unveiled on 28 August 2024, featuring Valli and Kadhirvelan and also revealing the upcoming release date. The serial was released on 2 September 2024,

title: Veera
summary: Veera is a 2024 Indian Tamil language revenge drama television series starring Vaishnavi Arulmozhi and Arun Crizer in the leads with Subiksha Kayarohanam, Oorvambu Lakshmi, Pasanga Sivakumar, Sibbu Suryan and Siddarth Raj. It is airing on Zee Tamil from 26 February 2024. The series is directed by Siva Sekar under the banner of Sapphire Blue Production.
plot:
Veera is a young girl who lives with her mother, two sisters and brother. The family revolves around Pandiyan, who, along with his mother, defends Veera's childish antics. Maaran drinks alcohol and spends half his time roaming around town, much to his father's disapproval. His aunt is the only one that offers some support to him, along with his brothers.
When Pandiyan dies in a road collision caused by Maaran, the tale of events that cause both Veera and Maaran to marry, whilst her older sister Kanmani looks for revenge against Maaran form the premise of the story.
Veera found out the truth about Maaran did not cause Pandian's accident, that is Raghavan did. So, Veera falls in love with him.
Brinda later found out that Maaran did not cause Pandian's accident, rather Raghavan did and therefore begins to respect him. Still, Kanmani looks for revenge against Maaran without knowing the truth about Pandian's accident.
Kanmani found out the truth about Maaran did not cause Pandian's accident, that is Raghavan and she then understood how Veera loves Maaran and Brinda respects him.
Kanmani feels sorry for him and asks for Maaran's forgiveness. So, her revenge is canceled and she starts supporting him and all are now aware that Maaran is a kindhearted, innocent and hero, except his father Ramachandran.
They try to convince Kanmani to come home and live with Raghavan. But she refused until Maaran convinced her.
But for the first time, Kanmani avoids and ignores Raghavan just like Veera avoids Maaran. But Kanmani still respected and supported him. Finally, Ramachandran finds out the truth about Pandian's accident that is not Maaran, it is Raghavan did. They arrested Raghavan and Ramachandran is very heartbroken and realises that Maaran is a good person and feels sorry for him. Kanmani tries to convince Ramachandran to forgive Raghavan because it was an accident and when she was guilty, ashamed she tells the whole truth about her revenge. Not only that, she tries to tell Ramachandran to understand Maaran and he asks for forgiveness.
His father forgives Maaran and Raghavan. But actually, Viji killed her brother Pandian not Raghavan. They all become aware of that and Kanmani later loves Raghavan, with everyone becoming happy.
The story to be continued
reception: The show got a TVR of 3.69 on launching week on 26 February 2024. In July 2024, the series was the third most watched serial in Zee Tamil with 4.11 TVR.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Initially, the title of the serial was set to be 'Sivamurugan Textiles'. Due to undisclosed reasons, the first promo was released with a new name 'Veera' on 8 February 2024.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Vaishnavi Arulmozhi was cast as Veera, marking her return after Peranbu. Arun Crizer was cast as the male lead role, marking his return after Rajini. Sibbu Suryan was cast as in a cameo role.
On 17 May 2024, Santhana Bharathi was brought in for special appearances. On 7 August 2024, Prajin was cast in special appearance as Raja. On 13 February 2025, R. Pandiarajan was cast in special appearance as Judge.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The show began airing on Zee Tamil on 26 February 2024 from Monday to Friday, replacing Maari.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: The show got a TVR of 3.69 on launching week on 26 February 2024. In July 2024, the series was the third most watched serial in Zee Tamil with 4.11 TVR.

title: Video Cam Scam
summary:
Video Cam Scam is a 2024 Indian Hindi-language crime thriller streaming television series directed by Vaibhav Khisti for Epic On. It stars Rajneesh Duggal and Amruta Khanvilkar in lead roles, along with Farnaz Shetty, Kunj Anand and Aradhana Sharma in pivotal roles. The series is produced by Blue Drop Films and In10Media Pvt. Ltd. The series is based on real-life events about cybercrime and sextortion. 
The series premiered on 12 January 2024, on Epic On.
plot: The sextortion scam in which Vinay Kumar, an honest 35-year-old police sub-inspector, inadvertently falls prey to the video calling app by Sonu, Tittu, and Sweety, and how his life goes haywire in a snap of a finger. Concerning his wife and family's respect for him and his long-standing reputation, he worries about these things. Despite the challenging times the couple has gone through, his wife plays an important role in identifying the people behind these frauds.

Michael is devastated by the news of losing his child and seeing his wife slip into a coma. When he gives sketches of the traffic violators that he encountered on the day of the accident, Arjun discovers something shocking.

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Michael reminisces about his memories with Jessica, and shifts Jessica to a hospital in Chennai for a critical brain surgery. Arjun finds a personal connection to Michael’s accident and detains an important suspect. episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: Arjun finds details about a task force investigation, connecting Michael’s accident to a foiled terror attack. Meanwhile, another officer, SI Vinod, finds that one of the violators in Michael’s accident, Bharat, may have been wrongfully accused of murder of a prominent journalist Nirmala Dixit. At a family dinner with his fiance, Amrutha, Arjun recounts the pain of losing his mother.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: After looking at traffic CCTV footage, Arjun finds out that Akbar, an ex-cop who was suspended with Arjun’s help, is also involved in Michael’s case. Meanwhile, Jessica wakes up after surgery with amnesia and the doctor advises Michael to talk to her about their past to bring her memory back. Arjun enforces strict policing to nab Akbar and his accomplice who was driving the car that hit Michael.

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: Arjun and team interrogate Mr. X, the driver of the car that hit Michael and Jessica. Meanwhile, Bharath kidnaps SI Lokesh, the officer who accused him in the murder of Nirmala Dixit. Akbar meets Aslam and Junaid, the masterminds of the terrorist organization that is planning new attacks.

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: After the death of police officers, Arjun is ordered to shut Michael’s case and focus on investigating their deaths. Michael is upset that his case is closed and finds that one of the violators, Gautham, is known to his close associate Redanna. Arjun finds out that his detained suspect was part of the gang that killed his mother. Ramji meets Michael and tells him his story.

episodesList.title: Episode 7
episodesList.summary: Jana tells his story to Arjun and how his paths crossed with Vani Ramachandra. Arjun is pulled into the Nirmala Dixit investigation because of Bharath, and he makes startling discoveries about a criminal conspiracy that has a surprising connection to Arjun’s past. Michael meets Redanna to execute a sinister plan.

episodesList.title: Episode 8
episodesList.summary: Arjun meets the informer who had been passing information to Akbar, and comes up with a plan to foil possible terror attacks in the city. Michael discovers Arjun’s connection to his hit and run accident and confronts him. Ramulu heads towards the highway with his ambulance, at the same time when Arjun and Michael are heading towards the city, setting up an unexpected and decisive showdown.

title: Vadhuvu
summary: Vadhuvu is an Indian Telugu-language thriller drama television series written by Sahana Dutta and directed by Poluri Krishna. Produced by Srikanth Mohta and Mahendra Soni under the banner of Shree Venkatesh Films, it stars Avika Gor, Ali Reza and Nandu. It premiered 8 December 2023 on Disney+ Hotstar. This series is an official remake of Bengali Hoichoi series Indu.
plot:
Indu is about to get married into a mysterious family. She initially was supposed to be married to Sanjay but her sister Bhanu runs away with him. On the night before marriage, her family receives gifts from the groom's family. That includes a jackfruit that seems to have been stitched. Family opens it up to find a leaf in it.
Indu goes to her granny with the leaf and asks what it is, which turns out to be extremely poisonous devil's trumpet. On the other hand, Anand's family is also tense as he also had three failed attempts of getting married and both families want to get done with the wedding without any hiccups.
After marriage and between the ceremonies, Indu encounters many suspicious incidents which lead her to suspect on all her in-laws. Amidst this, news of her sister-in-law committing suicide takes family into storm and Indu comes to a conclusion that it is Arya, who is behind all this fassade.

title: Vera Maari Office
summary:
Vera Maari Office (transl. Different Office) is a 2023 Indian Tamil-language workplace comedy sitcom streaming television series starring RJ Vijay, Soundariya Nanjundan, Janani Ashok Kumar, Vishnu (Season 1), Lavanya, VJ Pappu, Raveena Daha (Season 2), Sritharana (Season 2) and Jaiseelan (Season 2). The series created by RJ Shivakanth and written by Sathya and Saravana for Aha Tamil.
The first season aired from 10 August 2023 to 26 October 2023 and aried on every Thursday to Saturday at 7PM for 54 episodes. The second season aired from 15 August 2024 and consisted of 50 episodes.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Indian online OTT platform, Aha Tamil confirmed through a press release on 31 May 2023, that it would distribute new Tamil Web serial, to be created and produced by Shivakanth under the banner of Kanaa Production. The series is directed by Chidambaram Manivannan. The poster features an Office conference room, which has many employees and everyone is depicting their roles and showcasing various emotions.
In June 2024, Aha Tamil confirmed through a social media to announce that Vera Maari Office will be getting a second season.

articleSections.title: Remake
articleSections.text: The series was remade in telugu language titled Vere Level Office that released first episode on 12 December 2024.
